summary_md:
# Dubbla bud på Stockholmsbörsen – ny oro i Mellanöstern

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-06-29  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

A Friday market-morning episode dominated by an M&A wave on the Stockholm exchange: care provider Ambea launched a cash-and-share bid for rival Humana at a ~27% premium, while Viva Wine Group's main owner proposed taking it private at a ~38% premium. The hosts see AI jitters in Asia and a soft oil price as net positive for industrials-heavy Stockholm, and flag Getinge as an attractive, cheap, defensive turnaround case. Overall constructive mood with active bid speculation on small-caps.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 GETI-B — Getinge | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Defensive, recurring revenues, low risk, P/E ~11; sum-of-parts: Acute Care at 7-9x EBITDA ≈ whole market cap, leaving Surgical Workflows + Life Science (1.7bn EBITDA) as free upside.

#### Reasoning

Analyst Ture Wester argues the valuation is very cheap with limited downside; nothing spectacular needs to happen for a good outcome. FX dampens growth this year but ~5% growth thereafter plus margin improvement drives earnings. Tariff exposure to the key US market is a risk but offsettable via price increases over time.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US tariffs cannot be offset by price increases
- if growth fails to reach ~5% post-FX drag
- if Acute Care margins deteriorate

> *"Det är defensivt, det är väldigt stor, mycket återkommande intäkter. Risken är ganska låg tycker jag... Det är väldigt billigt."*

---

### 🟡 HUMA — Humana | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Ambea bid (20 SEK cash + 0.3 shares, ~27% premium) values Humana cheaply at ~11.5x EBITDA; stock rose only 23%, leaving a possible merger-arbitrage spread below the premium.

#### Reasoning

Host and analyst view the bid as fair-to-attractive given complementary businesses and synergies in central functions. The stock trading slightly below the offer premium implies an arbitrage opportunity, but completion risk and the political election backdrop temper conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the bid is withdrawn or fails to complete
- if a regulatory/competition block emerges
- if no competing bid materialises

> *"Toppen på Humana blir ungefär 11,5 om jag har räknat rätt. Det är ändå ganska lågt. Jag tror att det här kan bli ändå ganska bra."*

---

### 🟡 VIVA — Viva Wine Group | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Main owner's buyout at ~38% premium; stock up ~35%, just under the offer. Apr-May organic sales -8% despite +33% headline on M&A; bid timed at trough earnings.

#### Reasoning

Analyst sees good timing for the owner to take the company private at a cyclical low in profits while still paying a healthy 38% premium, after a weak share-price run. With the stock trading slightly below the bid, limited residual upside remains absent a competing offer.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the take-private offer is not completed
- if organic sales decline accelerates beyond -8%
- if minority shareholders block the deal

> *"Och jag tycker att det är bra tajming för dem att köpa ut nu... När det är lite bottenvinster och ändå bra premie på 38%."*

---

### 🟡 AMBEA — Ambea | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Acquirer of Humana; analyst sees real synergies and a strategically sound combination amid structural growth in Nordic care demand, but Ambea shares fell 2.7% on the announcement.

#### Reasoning

CEO Mark Jensen cites rising care needs, rising regulatory/quality requirements favouring scale, and complementary cultures. Analyst expects synergies from shared central functions. Acquirer shares typically dip on bids; thesis hinges on deal execution and synergy capture.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Humana acquisition fails
- if expected synergies do not materialise
- if regulatory pressure on care providers intensifies

> *"Det verkar nog vara att det finns en del synergier. Man kan liksom samordna lite centrala stödfunktioner."*

---

### 🟢 SAAB-B — Saab | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Among large-cap top movers; Oxcap initiated coverage with an Overweight recommendation.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst (Oxcap) started coverage at Overweight, supporting a positive stance; mentioned in passing by the hosts without independent thesis, so conviction is limited.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Oxcap revises the rating lower
- if defence-sector momentum reverses

> *"Saab har fått en inledd bevakning från Oxcap med rekommendationen övervikt."*

---

### 🟡 INSTAL — Instalco | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Stock down ~1%; Pareto downgraded its recommendation to Hold from Buy.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst Pareto cut the rating to Hold from Buy, signalling reduced upside expectation. Reported as a fact by the hosts without further thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Pareto downgrades further to Sell
- if order intake weakens

> *"Instalco där har Pareto sänkt rekommendationen till behåll från tidigare köp."*

---

### 🟡 NOKIA — Nokia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Stock down ~1.3%; Handelsbanken downgraded its recommendation to Hold from Buy.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst Handelsbanken cut Nokia to Hold from Buy. Reported factually by the hosts with no independent view, supporting a neutral stance.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Handelsbanken downgrades further
- if telecom-equipment demand deteriorates

> *"Handelsbanken sänker rekommendationen till behåll från köp för Nokias del."*

---

### 🟠 HTRO — Hexatronic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Up 4% after announcing investment in a new fibre-optic subsea cable production line that will more than double capacity in that area.

#### Reasoning

Capacity expansion in subsea fibre is a growth-positive catalyst and the market reacted favourably (+4%), but the hosts only noted the news without a directional recommendation, so this is a watch rather than a conviction call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if subsea cable demand disappoints
- if the capacity investment pressures margins

> *"Hexatronic ser vi stiga 4. Där har man meddelat att man ska investera i en ny produktionslinje för fiberoptiska sjökablar."*

---

### 🟠 SKA-B — Skanska | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Won a 3.5bn SEK UK order but also took a 3.7bn SEK customer cancellation, both in Q2 2026 Europe order intake; stock around flat, expected to fall somewhat.

#### Reasoning

The offsetting order and customer-initiated cancellation net slightly negative for order intake, and the analyst expects the share to dip, while the underlying order book is seen as still relatively strong — a wait-and-see setup.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further cancellations follow
- if Q2 order intake comes in weak

> *"De har tagit en order i Storbritannien värd 3,5 miljarder kronor men man har också fått en avbokning som är värd motsvarande 3,7 miljarder kronor."*

---
